subject: English Language
name: Basic 4 English Language
description: Part 2 of the Basic 4 English Language curriculum covers Grammar Usage, Writing, Writing Conventions, and Extensive Reading. It builds on oral and reading skills to develop proficiency in written communication and grammatical structure.

strands.title: Grammar Usage at Word and Phrase Levels
strands.description: Developing understanding and usage of various grammatical structures including nouns, determiners, pronouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, idiomatic expressions, conjunctions, modals, and prepositions.

subStrands.title: Nouns
subStrands.description: Identifying and using different types of nouns.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of nouns in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use nouns to identify people, animals, events and objects

exemplars.description: Read simple sentences having names of people, animals, events and objects.
Identify names of people, animals, events and objects as nouns.
Form sentences with nouns and underline them.

indicators.description: Identify and use proper nouns and common nouns

exemplars.description: Read sentences with names of cities and countries.
Identify proper nouns on a map or globe.
Identify common nouns in context.

indicators.description: Identify and use collective nouns to refer to a group of objects and people

exemplars.description: Read sentences containing collective nouns (e.g., team, swarm, flock).
Use collective nouns in sentences.

indicators.description: Identify and use abstract nouns to refer to concepts and ideas

exemplars.description: Read sentences containing abstract nouns.
Identify abstract nouns (e.g., beauty, peace).

subStrands.title: Determiners
subStrands.description: Using articles, quantifiers, possessives, demonstratives, and interrogatives.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of determiners in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use the definite and indefinite articles 'a' and 'an'

exemplars.description: Read sentences containing articles.
Use indefinite and definite articles appropriately.

indicators.description: Identify and use quantifiers to show quantities

exemplars.description: Use quantifiers like some, few, little, many.

indicators.description: Identify and use possessive pronouns to show possession

exemplars.description: Use possessive pronouns like my, your, his, their.

indicators.description: Identify and use demonstratives: this/that, these/those

exemplars.description: Use demonstratives in sentences.

indicators.description: Identify and use interrogative determiners which, whose

exemplars.description: Use interrogative determiners to ask questions.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of pronouns in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use different types of pronouns

exemplars.description: Use personal pronouns (I, You, He, She, We).
Use interrogative pronouns (Who, What, Where).

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of adjectives in communication

indicators.description: Use adjectives to make comparison

exemplars.description: Use comparative adjectives (e.g., faster, slower).

subStrands.title: Verbs
subStrands.description: Using main verbs, helping verbs, and tenses.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of verbs in communication

indicators.description: Use different types of verbs: Main verb and Helping verb

exemplars.description: Identify main and auxiliary verbs in sentences.

indicators.description: Use appropriate subject-verb agreement

exemplars.description: Match singular subjects with singular verbs and plural subjects with plural verbs.

indicators.description: Use the simple present form of verbs

exemplars.description: Use simple present for habitual actions and universal truths.

indicators.description: Use regular form of the simple past tense of verbs

exemplars.description: Form past tense by adding 'ed' or 'd'.

indicators.description: Use the simple past form of verbs for completed actions

exemplars.description: Narrate completed actions using simple past tense.

indicators.description: Use the imperative form of the verb to give commands or orders

exemplars.description: Give and respond to commands.

subStrands.title: Adverbs
subStrands.description: Using adverbs of time and place.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of different types of adverbs in communication

indicators.description: Use adverbs of time and place appropriately

exemplars.description: Use adverbs like here, there, outside, yesterday, today.

contentStandards.description: Understand and use idiomatic expressions

indicators.description: Use idiomatic expressions appropriately in communication

exemplars.description: Identify meaning of idioms in context.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of conjunctions in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Identify and use simple conjunctions - and, but, or, nor

exemplars.description: Link similar and contrasting ideas using conjunctions.

subStrands.title: Modals
subStrands.description: Using modals to express ability, permission, and obligation.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of modals in speech and in writing

indicators.description: Use modals to express a variety of meanings

exemplars.description: Use modals such as can, may, must, should.

subStrands.title: Prepositions
subStrands.description: Using prepositions to convey direction, time, and purpose.

contentStandards.description: Apply the knowledge of prepositions in oral and written communication

indicators.description: Use prepositions to convey a variety of meanings

exemplars.description: Use prepositions for direction, time, purpose, possession, comparison.

strands.title: Writing
strands.description: Developing writing skills through penmanship, paragraph development, and various writing modes.

contentStandards.description: Copy and rewrite sentences correctly

indicators.description: Write clearly using joined letters of consistent size

exemplars.description: Practice writing letters with a flick, joining pairs, and writing sentences.

indicators.description: Use simple sentences clearly and correctly

exemplars.description: Begin proper nouns with capital letters.

contentStandards.description: Develop, organise and express ideas cohesively in writing

indicators.description: Choose appropriate ways and modes of writing

exemplars.description: Identify modes like expository, narrative, description, argument.

indicators.description: Identify the main idea and supporting details in a paragraph

exemplars.description: Identify main and supporting ideas in sample paragraphs.

subStrands.title: Writing as a Process
subStrands.description: Applying the writing process from brainstorming to publishing.

contentStandards.description: Apply the skills and strategies for idea generation

indicators.description: Select a topic, brainstorm and organise ideas

exemplars.description: Brainstorm and organize ideas using graphic organizers.

contentStandards.description: Develop and express ideas cohesively

indicators.description: Develop ideas into a one-paragraph draft

exemplars.description: Draft a paragraph with a beginning, middle, and end.

contentStandards.description: Apply strategies for improving drafts

indicators.description: Review and revise the draft

exemplars.description: Revise for clarity and relevance.

indicators.description: Proofread draft

exemplars.description: Check capitalization, punctuation, and spelling.

indicators.description: Display writing piece

exemplars.description: Publish and share work.

subStrands.title: Narrative Writing
subStrands.description: Writing narratives with structure and description.

contentStandards.description: Narrate situations and express feelings

indicators.description: Write about real or imagined experiences

exemplars.description: Write narratives with plot, setting, and character description.

subStrands.title: Creative/Free Writing
subStrands.description: Writing freely on topics of choice.

contentStandards.description: Create texts

indicators.description: Write freely about topics of choice

exemplars.description: Write about topics in the immediate environment.

indicators.description: Write poems and imaginative stories

exemplars.description: Compose short poems and imaginative narratives.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate knowledge of descriptive words

indicators.description: Use descriptive words/expressions

exemplars.description: Describe places, personal experiences, and events.

contentStandards.description: Support an opinion in writing

indicators.description: Support opinions with simple sentences

exemplars.description: Express opinions for or against a motion.

contentStandards.description: Write arguments to support claims

indicators.description: Introduce claim(s) and support them

exemplars.description: Provide reasons and evidence for opinions.

indicators.description: Use words to clarify relationships

exemplars.description: Use appropriate language for arguments.

indicators.description: Establish and maintain a formal style

exemplars.description: Structure arguments with introduction, reasons, and conclusion.

indicators.description: Provide a concluding statement

exemplars.description: Write concluding statements for arguments.

contentStandards.description: Write informative essays

indicators.description: Write words giving information about family

exemplars.description: Write about self and family.

contentStandards.description: Write an event of the day

indicators.description: Write picture events about personal experiences

exemplars.description: Write news items from pictures or daily activities.

contentStandards.description: Write informal letters on given topics

indicators.description: Write to friends about personal experiences

exemplars.description: Identify features of friendly letters and write one.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of how punctuations are used appropriately

indicators.description: Use the comma

exemplars.description: Use commas with Yes/No and addressing persons.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of different types of nouns in communication

indicators.description: Identify and use nouns in sentences

exemplars.description: Identify and use common and proper nouns in sentences.

indicators.description: Identify and use proper nouns and common nouns

exemplars.description: Distinguish between proper and common nouns.

indicators.description: Identify and use collective nouns

exemplars.description: Use collective nouns in sentences.

indicators.description: Identify and use abstract nouns

exemplars.description: Use abstract nouns in sentences.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of verbs in everyday language

indicators.description: Use singular and plural subjects and verb forms

exemplars.description: Ensure subject-verb agreement in writing.

indicators.description: Demonstrate use of simple past form

exemplars.description: Rewrite sentences in simple past tense.

indicators.description: Use present perfect form of verbs

exemplars.description: Use present perfect tense to relate past to present.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of adjectives in speech and writing

indicators.description: Use adjectives to make comparisons

exemplars.description: Use comparative forms of adjectives.

indicators.description: Differentiate between comparative and superlative forms

exemplars.description: Use both comparative and superlative forms in descriptions.

subStrands.title: Using Adverbs
subStrands.description: Using adverbs of time and place.

contentStandards.description: Understand and use adverbs correctly

indicators.description: Use adverbs to talk about when and where

exemplars.description: Use adverbs of time and place in narration.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of prepositions

indicators.description: Use prepositions to convey a variety of meanings

exemplars.description: Use prepositions for direction, time, purpose, possession, comparison.

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of conjunctions

indicators.description: Identify and use conjunctions

exemplars.description: Use 'and', 'but', 'or', 'nor' to link ideas.

subStrands.title: Using Simple, Compound and Complex Sentences

contentStandards.description: Apply knowledge of grammatical rules

indicators.description: Identify subjects and verbs in simple sentences

exemplars.description: Identify subject and verb in sentences.

indicators.description: Construct simple sentences correctly

exemplars.description: Build paragraphs using simple sentences with correct subject-predicate structure.

contentStandards.description: Spell words accurately

indicators.description: Use invented spelling to increase fluency

exemplars.description: Spell words related to various topics.

subStrands.title: Building the Love and Culture of Reading
subStrands.description: Reading for pleasure and independent learning.

contentStandards.description: Read widely for pleasure and personal development

indicators.description: Read a variety of age- and level appropriate books

exemplars.description: Read books independently and present summaries.
